text_block_list.text:
After finishing our errands, Winning Ticket and I
returned to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm baaack, Hayahide! Taishin!
So, let's go play futsal!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why futsal out of nowhere?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well, I saw some folks playing futsal on my way back,
and it just got me all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Emotions I've never known will make me stronger!!
That's why I play futsal!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wait, Ticket, do you even know the rules of futsal?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know the rules.
My dad explained them to me before.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Dad's a pro sports trainer,
so he knows all about this kind of stuff!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ho, a professional trainer?
Fascinating. What is your specialty?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Well, I don't really know!
But it's just amazing in all kinds of ways!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I just wish
you knew at least a little about your own parents...
Thanks to Winning Ticket's practically forceful, fiery invitations, the members were gathered in no time.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooh, it's finally kickoff timeee!
Futsal really is the best, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"There's an excitement here you can't find in races!
Yes, this! This is what I was looking for!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"An excitement not found in racing? They are both sports,
so what is the difference?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's obvious, duh!
It's—...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That means I can be on the same team
as Hayahide and Taishin!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Normally, we're rivals on the track, right?
So if someone wins, someone else has to lose...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
With futsal, all three of us can win together, right?
Isn't that awesome?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Getting to taste the joy of victory together with
Taishin and Hayahide is the absolute beeest!!
Waaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's what happened.
You got me there, Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I told you, it wasn't taken from me, not really...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So, what's my position? We can't really
play futsal until we decide that, you know.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, indeed. While Ticket won't lose out in physical clashes,
positioning is crucial given her clumsy nature.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Let's ask Trainer for some advice here.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Positioning, huh?! Well, if I have a choice, I want the spot where I can get the most emotional!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, where, where!?
Where do you recommend!?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, a striker! That's the one at the very front
who just shoots and shoots, right?!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Every point we score is a thrill!!
Whoaaa, let's do this!
(PEEEEEEEEEEEEEP!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, brought it right in front of the goal!
Ticket, pass! Come on, shoot!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, take thiiiiiis! Jumping,
no-trap, winning shoo...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Don't mind if I do!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aaagh, the baaallll!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Idiot! Why are you talking so much?
Just hurry up and take your swing!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket...
Was that catchphrase really necessary?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuu, it's theeeere!!
It really is theeeere!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Saying it with conviction and settling it decisively
is what makes it truly moving!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, then at least devise a plan. If you get overtaken right before
the goal, your logic for victory collapses.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Got it! Next time... Next time for suuure!
Winning Ticket charged toward the goal once more.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, here I goooo! Jumping,
no-trap, winning shoo...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Everyone, slide! Charge!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Are you kidding me?! This is just
a repeat of what happened before...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO, even if you slide tackle
all of us at onceee...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"IF I JUST ENDURE IT!
I'll be fiiiiine!! Dwooooaaaahhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah!!
Winning Ticket blew away the barrage of sliding tackles coming her way!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"She knocked it right back... without any tactic whatsoever...
What ridiculous brute force..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, here I go! Jumping,
No-Trap——, Winning Shoot!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —!? What is this pitch power!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No one can stop her.
That's Ticket for you...

Carried by the exact same momentum as her catchphrase,
the ball flew forward—
It sailed far above the crossbar.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOAAAH, no waaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
To miss after setting the stage this thoroughly...
...In a way, isn't that almost impressive?

The game was a disaster, but she gained both moving memories
and the sheer grit to endure sliding.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Goalkeeper!! If you block every incoming shot, it's bound to be super inspiring, right?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, with Ticket's strong core, she might be well-suited for it.
Alright, let's go with that formation.
—And thus, the match began.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin—I'm passing to you!
Get in front of the goal!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"OK! Slipping behind the defender,
and in one go—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Out of the way, out of the way, out of the waaay, hyaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Ticket?!
Why is the goalkeeper pushing up?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Well... watching made me want to take a shot too, you know...?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin, Hayahide!! Can I play as
an attacking goalkeeper!?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, a goalkeeper taking penalty kicks isn't
entirely unheard of in history, but...
Afterward, Winning Ticket ran around relentlessly on both offense and defense.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa,
attack, defend, attaackkk!!
Winning Ticket transformed into the Prince of Light Speed dancing across the field!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
S-She's glowing...
From sheer speed...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if one can traverse back and forth at such speed,
a two-sword style might actually be possible.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it, I'll totally do it! I know
I can do this!! Uwooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, counterattack!
Aim for when the keeper pushes up!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh, a counter...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uwoooooon, a total defeaaaat!!

Faced with the enemy's sharp, calculated strategy,
she suffered a bitter defeat.
However, she seems to have gained some agility.
